name: schema_overview
description: Discover available labels, node counts and relationships before choosing a traversal.

name: schema_search
description: Find labels, relationships and properties relevant to a search term.

name: schema_describe_label
description: Inspect one label, its properties and its incoming and outgoing relationships.

name: schema_describe_relationship
description: Inspect endpoint labels, direction and properties for a relationship type.

name: inspect_paths
description: Find candidate schema paths from a source label to an optional target label.

name: summarize_handle
description: Inspect the type, bindings, columns and a small sample of a workflow handle.

name: handle_recap
description: Review how a workflow handle was produced.

name: repair_empty_result
description: Suggest ways to diagnose an empty result or a failed tool call.

name: entity_resolve
description: Resolve text to graph nodes using names, aliases and optional context.

name: node_search
description: Find nodes of a label with an exact property value.

name: node_scan
description: Scan a bounded number of nodes of one label.

name: count_nodes
description: Count all nodes of one label.

name: count_handle
description: Count rows or distinct entities in a workflow result.

name: expand
description: Follow one relationship from entities in an existing handle.

name: expand_aggregate
description: Traverse one relationship and aggregate the resulting bindings.

name: optional_expand_count
description: Count related nodes while retaining source entities that have no matches.

name: optional_count_by_pattern
description: Evaluate a source pattern and count optional relationships from its bindings.

name: relationship_query
description: Query a single relationship between two labels with filters and projections.

name: multi_hop_query
description: Follow a sequence of typed relationships and return or aggregate bindings.

name: pattern_query
description: Match a bounded graph pattern with filters, selection, grouping and ordering.

name: top_entities_by_property
description: Rank entities by one property and return a limited result.

name: constraint_query
description: Find entities that satisfy independent one-hop constraints.

name: entity_set_operation
description: Union, intersect or subtract sets of entities from multiple handles.

name: filter
description: Keep rows whose bound entity satisfies a property predicate.

name: filter_same_node
description: Keep rows where two bindings refer to the same node.

name: join_handles
description: Join handles on entity identity or select matching or nonmatching left rows.

name: same_target_role_intersection
description: Find entity pairs connected by all required relationship roles.

name: shared_role_aggregate
description: Find peers through shared entities and optionally aggregate their bindings.

name: combine
description: Apply a set operation to two workflow handles.

name: group_handle
description: Group rows and compute counts or numeric aggregates.

name: project
description: Select and order result columns, optionally retaining entity bindings or expanding lists.

name: compare
description: Compare a property of one entity with the same property of another entity.

name: fetch
description: Return a page of result rows. Follow next_offset until it is null.

name: draft_tool_plan
description: Suggest a short sequence of tools for investigating a graph question.

name: validate_tool_plan
description: Check whether a proposed sequence uses known tools and valid arguments.

name: value_search
description: Search a property for matching values or the entities that own them.

name: scalar_compute
description: Compute an arithmetic result from cells in existing table handles.
